*I’d hold this release for one high-priority bug.*

*P1 — Renewal dates use the wrong month’s length*  
`src/schedule.js:6–7` clamps the anchor against the *source* month, then constructs a date in the *next* month. This causes both skipped renewal months and lost anchor days:

| From | Anchor | Expected | Actual |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Jan 31, 2026 | 31 | Feb 28 | Mar 3 |
| Jan 31, 2028 | 31 | Feb 29 | Mar 2 |
| Feb 28, 2026 | 31 | Mar 31 | Mar 28 |
| Apr 30, 2026 | 31 | May 31 | May 30 |

JavaScript rolls invalid dates into the following month, so this can delay billing past an entire renewal month. Clamp against the *target month’s* length instead, retaining the original anchor.

*Validation:* All 5 existing tests pass, but an additional calendar sweep covering every anchor across 2024–2028 found 66 incorrect results out of 1,860 cases. Add regression coverage for shorter target months, leap-year February, and returning from a short month to the original anchor.

Reviewed `billing-anniversary` at `f73b00d` against `main` at `7f89e48`. No files changed.
